config.notes: Adelaide University (merged Univ. of Adelaide + UniSA, teaching from 2026). Stored pages are all the new Adelaide University degree pages (/study/degrees/<slug>/, international view), on adelaide.edu.au and adelaideuni.edu.au (adelaideuni.edu.au now 302-redirects to adelaide.edu.au); no old degree-finder or UniSA pages are stored. Key-facts panel: "Start date ... Exact start date is outlined in the course timetable. February, July" (months printed; research degrees say any time of year - not read); "Indicative annual fees ... on a full-time annual basis. $52,500" (international annual; the variant "Where the duration of the program is less than one year, the total cost of the program is displayed" is a whole-program total and is deliberately NOT read; research "2027 Annual Fee ... differs across study areas" not read); "IELTS Overall 6.5" with bands per page; Duration "3 year(s) full-time"; Campus list; Mode "On campus". Academic calendar: https://adelaide.edu.au/students/manage-study/academic-calendar/ (2026 Semester 1 starts 23 Feb, Semester 2 starts 3 Aug; 2027 22 Feb / 2 Aug). No term_months used: course pages print months.
